summary.en: The last world shrinks into the anchor, which squashes and strikes on the bar line; a ring runs out and a burst of dots condenses onto the claim letters.
summary.zh: 上一屏整体缩进锚点，锚点压扁后在小节线上击出；一道圆环扩散，一阵网点飞出凝成主张的字。

fits: The climax of a print film: one claim in one or two lines.
notFor: Claims longer than two short lines; quiet films.

intent.en: Everything the film showed collapses into the one brand piece and bursts out as the claim, so the claim reads as what it all adds up to.
intent.zh: 片里展示的一切塌进那块品牌件，再爆成主张，主张读起来就是一切的总和。

content.en: One or two claim lines (≤ 15 chars / 8 字 each); the field kind of the world that collapses.
content.zh: 一到两行主张（每行 ≤ 15 字符 / 8 字）；塌缩前那一屏的场种类。

fits.zh: 印刷风格片的高潮：一两行主张。

notFor.zh: 超过两行的主张；安静的片。

en: The strike must sit on a bar line; the anticipation squash only works if it holds still.
zh: 击出必须落在小节线上；预备的压扁只有静止才成立。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
